messages:
Ravi (Product): Quick sync — customer FinEdge asked for 5yr+ audit-log retention, exportable evidence packages, and a pricing model that doesn't blow up their TCO. Need a concrete plan for sprint planning.

Asha (Sales): This is in our top 4 deals this quarter. They want a predictable per-tenant price for retention beyond 2yrs. Also asked for export in a format their auditors accept (ISO-friendly).

Maya (Security): Two security constraints: 1) evidence must include integrity proofs (hash chain or Merkle root) + signed attestations; 2) if CMEK is used, we need to preserve wrapped DEKs per rotation to allow decryption of historical logs.

Jon (Eng): Implementation sketch:
- Retention tiers: standard (90d), extended (2yr), archival (up to 10yr).
- Store logs in compressed, deduped objects (parquet/ndjson.gz), lifecycle transition to cold blob storage.
- Export job creates a tar.gz with: logs, manifest (file hashes), Merkle root, Redwood-signed statement (timestamp + export parameters).
- Retrieval SLA: estimate creation time proportional to dataset size (e.g., 1TB ~ 4h). We can parallelize exports.

Priya (Legal): Export artifacts need a chain-of-custody: who requested, who approved, export hash, signing key serial, and a certified time-stamp. 5 business days turnaround is reasonable for large exports. Also need legal-hold flow to pin data and record approvals.

Asha (Sales): Customers will accept Redwood-signed manifests for initial contracts, but larger firms ask for signing tied to their KMS/HSM. Can we offer HSM signing as an enterprise add-on?

Maya (Security): HSM signing is an enterprise feature — adds attestation complexity. MVP: Redwood HSM signing (managed) + option to ingest customer attestation later. Include notarized timestamping via our time-stamp authority.

Jon (Eng): Cost estimate note: 100k daily requests ~ 8GB/day of logs after compression => ~14.6TB/5yr. Cold storage costs + egress for exports matter. Proposed commercial approach: base storage charge (GB-month) + export bandwidth fee + an archival retrieval SLA tier (standard vs expedited).

Ravi (Product): OK — we need acceptance criteria for launch. Drafting:
- Must: per-tenant retention config up to 5yr, exportable evidence package with signed manifest and Merkle root, audit trail for export requests, legal-hold pinning, CMEK support with wrapped DEK epochs.
- Should: retrieval SLA defined (standard 5 biz days, expedited for fee), per-tenant pricing model (GB-month + export fee), UI + API to request exports.
- Nice-to-have: customer HSM signing, append-only WORM store, on-prem package for exports.

Maya (Security): Also must include key-rotation FAQ for customers: how we retain wrapped keys and how revocation affects past exports. Add that to docs.

Priya (Legal): Add requirement: export manifest includes a human-readable cover letter for auditors summarizing schema, hash algorithms, and time-range.

Jon (Eng): Dev plan (high level): 3 sprints for MVP backend + 1 sprint for UI, plus infra for long-term cold storage. Need infra estimate for monthly GB retention and a prototype export runner.

Asha (Sales): I'll collect the six customers who asked and map to revenue tiers. We should propose enterprise surcharge for archival >2yrs.

Ravi (Product): Action items:
1) Jon: prototype export runner and storage cost estimate (due Thu).
2) Maya: security design for Merkle proofs + HSM options (due Thu).
3) Priya: produce export artifact checklist + legal-hold flow (due Wed).
4) Asha: customer tiering + proposed pricing buckets (due Fri).

infra-bot: Created task PROD-4301 "Audit evidence delivery + retention pricing scoping" assigned to @Jon, @Maya, @Ravi. Due in 7 days.

Ravi (Product): Thanks — we'll reconvene in 1 week with numbers. If anyone needs to reprioritize, drop a note here. :sparkles:
